test_test_tracking: test the python module test_tracking to evaluate a multi-object tracking model with separate detector and reid checkpoints
run_test_tracking: run the test_tracking CLI to test and evaluate an MMTrack model using a config file, checkpoint, and work directory
build_test_tracking_runner: build a test runner from config using Runner.from_cfg or RUNNERS.build for customized multi-object tracking evaluation
load_test_tracking_checkpoints: load separate detector and reid checkpoints into a wrapped tracking model for multi-object tracking inference
parse_test_tracking_args: parse CLI arguments for test_tracking including config, checkpoint paths, work directory, launcher, and cfg options
